question.problem:
Consider the system $Ax=b$, where the matrix $A$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Given that the columns of $A$ are linearly independent, find the minimum value of $‖Ax-b‖.$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 20 \\ -1 \\ 17\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
First of all, we write the given system in the form $Ax=b:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}]}}\overset{x}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{b}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 20 \\ -1 \\ 17\end{aligned}]}} \\ Ax & =b\end{aligned}
$$

We can find the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{x}$ of the equation above by solving the corresponding normal equation, which we obtain by left-multiplying our original equation by ${A}^{T}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{T}\,A\overset{^}{x} & ={A}^{T}b\end{aligned}
$$

Since the columns of $A$ are linearly independent, the matrix ${A}^{T}\,A$ is invertible. Therefore, multiplying by $({A}^{T}\,A)^{-1}$ on the left, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{^}{x} & =({A}^{T}\,A)^{-1}{A}^{T}b \\  & ={([\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}])}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}10 \\ 20 \\ -1 \\ 17\end{aligned}] \\  & ={[\begin{aligned}8 & -2 \\ -2 & 6\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}22 \\ 44\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{22}[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ 1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}22 \\ 44\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The minimum value of $‖Ax-b‖$ is attained when $x=\overset{^}{x},$ which is the least-squares solution of the system $Ax=b.$ In this case, $A\overset{^}{x}$ represents the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto the column space of $A,$ and $‖A\overset{^}{x}-b‖$ is the distance between the vector $b$ and the column space. Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}A\overset{^}{x}-b & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 \\ -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ 9\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 20 \\ -1 \\ 17\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-9 \\ -11 \\ -9 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, 

$$
‖A\overset{^}{x}-b‖=\sqrt{(-9)^{2}+(-11)^{2}+(-9)^{2}+{1}^{2}}=2\sqrt{71}.
$$
